about: Monster numbers. Every species starts from base and lists only what is different. hp in hit points, times in seconds, distances in metres. body.hop follows the model's Jumping clip: it leaves the ground at liftOff and lands at land (seconds of clip time). scale sizes the whole slime; tint recolours its body (null keeps the model's own blue); pace plays its clips faster (above 1) or slower; stride is how far each hop goes compared with the normal one; radius is how much room it takes. takes: how much of each element's damage it takes (1 = normal, above 1 = weak to it). A slime that is hit gets angry for anger.time seconds: it chases the player (never further than anger.leash from home) and attacks; the blow lands at attack.strikeAt of attack.cycle if the player is within attack.reach. A red ring on the ground warns of every blow of an angry monster for at least attack.warn seconds (it holds its wind-up until the ring has shown that long); a special move's warning runs from its start to the moment it strikes, which must be at least warnSpecial seconds. Slimes that are not angry only threaten and never hurt. model: which model it is drawn with (an id in apps/citywalk/public/assets.json). pitch: voice pitch (1 = by its size, below 1 is deeper). knock: how much a skill's push-back moves it (a heavy boss barely moves). specials: moves only some monsters have, each with the name of its animation (null = it does not have that move). charge: crouch and aim, then dash in a straight line (from dashStart to dashEnd seconds of clip time, speed in metres per second) and hit whoever it runs into (reach); used when the player is min to max metres away. slam: rear up and bring its arms down at strikeAt, hurting everyone within radius metres. cooldown is the seconds before a move may be used again. A monster uses its specials only while it is angry. exp: what beating one gives. drops: what it may leave behind: item id, chance 0..1, and how many (min..max).
